description: Solo first hackathon team making an interactive story!
summary: Our game is a storytelling game that splits ingenuity's legacy into 3 options. It addresses the challenge by telling you it's purpose and events while you play. It is important because Ingenuity is the first helicopter on another planet. Another Planet! That achievement deserves to be alongside Apollo 11.
details: You can pick from 3 choices to play an interactive game while reading the story of Ingenuity. The benefits are you gain knowledge about the legacy of Ingenuity. I used Scratch to develop my project. I used 3 options and let players read while playing while not being stressed. We considered attention, accuracy and fun, it is more of a concept rather than a full game, warning, has many bugs, please close and open again if something unintended happens.
